commits.subject: build(flexlb): package test fixtures
commits.change_and_validation_details:
build(flexlb): package shared test fixtures as test jars

Validate the isolated seven-POM change with 4147 reactor tests (0 failures, 0 errors, 3 skipped) and full Spotless. On B300, all 1296 compiled production class hashes match HEAD. Existing E2E latency and receiving-limit failures also reproduce on HEAD; this commit does not claim the absolute performance gates pass.

commits.subject: refactor(flexlb): remove unused health metric
commits.change_and_validation_details:
refactor(flexlb): remove unused status failure latency reporting

Remove the uncalled failure-latency reporter, metric registration and
constant. Keep the existing failure counters and their tags unchanged.

Validation: isolated EngineHealthReporterTest, 42 tests passed; full-reactor
Spotless passed. An independent perf run for this commit is pending.
BATCH end-to-end perf failures also occur on the baseline; this commit
is explicitly authorized without claiming that perf acceptance passed.

existing routing-decision snapshot in PV logs.

receiving-limit errors and long JVM safepoint waits affected the runs.
This commit is explicitly authorized with those failures retained.

commits.subject: refactor(flexlb): simplify scheduling and placement
commits.change_and_validation_details:
refactor(flexlb): checkpoint scheduler and placement simplification

Consolidate common request handling in AbstractRequestScheduler and retain
scheduling timing and request selection in concrete scheduling policies.
Separate immutable route selections/results from execution resources, and
centralize placement publication and cleanup. Include the related endpoint,
projection, tests, fixtures and architecture updates from the working tree.

This is an explicitly requested checkpoint so further validation can move
to an isolated worktree and the current workspace can be used for new work.

Validation evidence: prior full working-tree UT run completed 4207 tests,
0 failures/errors, 3 skipped; later focused routing tests passed 81 cases.
Independent telemetry cleanup reactor completed 4147 tests with no failures.
Full-reactor formatting checks passed before checkpoint creation.

Performance acceptance remains open. Prior B300 runs include P99 failures,
receiving-limit errors and long JVM safepoint waits; they are not claimed
as passing performance validation of this exact checkpoint. Follow-up
measurements must identify this commit and preserve failed runs.
